scripts.build: bun run schema:check && bun run --filter './packages/*' build
scripts.test:reference: bun run build && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/playground' build && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/playground' test:e2e
scripts.test:all: bun run build && bun run --filter '!@puzzle-ui/storage-mongodb' vitest && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/create' test && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/ui' test:browser && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/pieces' test:browser && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/storage-mongodb' vitest && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/playground' build && bun run --filter '@puzzle-ui/playground' test:e2e
scripts.benchmark:seo: bun run build && bun run packages/seo/scripts/benchmark.ts
scripts.benchmark:rendering: bun run build && bun run --filter workspace-next build && bun run --filter workspace-tanstack build && node scripts/benchmark-rendering.mjs
scripts.benchmark:rendering:smoke: bun run build && bun run --filter workspace-next build && bun run --filter workspace-tanstack build && node scripts/benchmark-rendering.mjs --smoke
